note: Points read from published figures by the archive author (data/digitized of the archive, CC0-1.0). Photon energies in meV. Only the curves are given; no peak readings.

koenig1961_Mg2Si_band.source: Koenig, Lynch and Danielson, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 20, 122 (1961), Fig. 1, n-type Mg2Si sample 27B01; background A*E^-2.5+B subtracted by the archive author; vertical axis in relative units (pixels of the figure).

lott1966_Mg2Ge_band.source: Lott and Lynch, Phys. Rev. 141, 681 (1966), n-type Mg2Ge; vertical axis as read from the figure above its background (relative units).

koenig1961_interband_edges.source: Koenig, Lynch and Danielson (1961), Fig. 3: absorption coefficient (cm^-1) near the interband edge. The key MgSi_93K is the archive label of the Mg2Si curve at 93 K.
